text:
Alicia: CI on main is red — build #2987 failing at decrypt step. seeing KMS AccessDenied in the job logs. can someone eyeball?
CI-bot: Workflow run failed: build-2987 (e2e-inference-tests) — see https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/2987
Ben: which job step? decrypt step or fetching secrets from vault? :eyes:
Alicia: decrypt step in setup job. log excerpt:
```
DecryptError: AccessDenied
status code: 403, request id: abc123
arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef01-2345
```
Alicia: I tried a manual rerun but it immediately failed again, so I think it's permission keyed to the runner/role.
DevOps: looks like KMS denies. can someone check the runner's IAM role or the KMS key policy? common causes: alias rotation, vault sync dropped mapping, or runner OIDC refresh failure. run: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01-2345 --policy-name default`
Marta: @Alicia do you know if anyone rotated the key alias or did a vault rotation in the last 6h? I can check vault sync logs.
Alicia: hmm PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 updated alias -> maybe related. I also see STS 401s earlier in the runner logs.
Sam: I can bisect. first step: can someone trigger a single-job rerun with debug logs enabled? if rerun hits same error, i'll bisect by committing reverted alias mapping.
Ben: also consider restarting affected self-hosted runner; if token expired the runner won't refresh. `systemctl restart actions.runner.redwood.service` on the host did help last time.
DevOps: pulling vault-sync logs now. there is a 404 mapping miss at 2026-03-17T09:41:22Z and a failed write to secrets/kms-aliases. looks like sync job failed due to transient S3 error. patching and will re-sync.
CI-bot: Rerun requested by Sam — job queued.
Alicia: thanks — if we can get a quick rerun that would unblock the release. :thumbsup:
DevOps: re-synced alias mappings, restarted runner, and kicked a manual job rerun (build-2987). monitoring logs — will post updates.
CI-bot: build-2987 rerun started by DevOps
DevOps: logs show decrypt step now returns `Decrypt OK` and subsequent steps proceeding. marking as unblocked.
Alicia: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll watch the release pipeline and file a follow-up postmortem note.
Marta: filing a short incident note in #incidents to track root cause (vault-sync retry logic + self-hosted runner token handling).
Ben: nice triage.
Sam: if it flaps again ping me and i'll start bisect. :+1:
